historical_executions.label: Four classical rate engines' median F0-distribution shift on ten AMI windows
historical_executions.scope: Ten four-second AMI windows at six constant rate factors in one research pilot. The median F0-distribution shift is a pitch-preservation proxy under rate change, not a designated pitch shift, formant measurement, prosody edit or listening result. The single Rubber Band row maps to both offline and streaming components and is not split into invented per-mode values. Audio, engine builds and rights are not present here; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.scope: Measured classical rate control at 1.25x and 0.8x. The autocorrelation F0-distribution shift is a source-reported pitch-preservation proxy, not a designated pitch-shift, formant or prosody result, and the exact FFmpeg build and GPL configuration are not reproduced here; not rerun by this survey.
